plan_failed: Calculation failed: {error}. Previous reports are not a valid current forecast.
plan_intro: As of {date}. Scheduled remaining effort: {assigned:.2f} person-days. Known unscheduled effort: {unassigned:.2f} person-days; {unknown} additional items are unestimated. Done and cancelled items consume no future capacity.
empty_schedule: No unfinished PBI is scheduled. The Sprint and capacity rows below are configuration, not a delivery plan. Unestimated effort is not zero.
plan_basis: Owners must enter remaining availability after the forecast date in People. The tool does not infer holidays or consumed effort, optimize the schedule, or assign a delivery probability.
capacity_header: | Sprint | Role | Remaining person-days | Available person-days | Balance | State |
items_header: | PBI | Delivery state | Original person-days | Remaining person-days | Sprint |
no_conflict: No detectable dependency conflict. External commitments still require confirmation.
plan_decisions: Address overload by splitting work, rescheduling, changing scope or adjusting allocation. More people generally cannot remove an external wait. Preserve the prior forecast, record the decision and recalculate.
blocked: {id}: still blocked; spare capacity does not establish feasibility
external_late: {id}: external readiness falls after the Sprint ends; the delivery window is infeasible
external_wait: {id}: external waiting occurs within the Sprint; arrange the actual sequence
deadline: {id}: the assigned Sprint ends after the required deadline
dep_cancelled: {id}: predecessor {dep} was cancelled; revisit the dependency
dep_later: {id} depends on {dep}, which is scheduled later
dep_same: {id} depends on {dep} in the same Sprint; arrange sequencing
review_pending: Pending source review. Text extraction does not capture complete charts, layout or meaning.
evidence_review: Review the source and its applicable context.
excerpt_missing: Add an exact excerpt or an image-region description.
repo_scope: This configuration defines the local read scope. Sync does not execute repository code, install dependencies or modify OpenWiki.
